verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge with well-documented pull requests: opening PRs, diff review and feedback, stacked PRs, landing, and rulesets that require PRs, reviews and CODEOWNERS approval. Nothing in the pack shows forking, or a way for outside contributors without write access to propose changes back, so only the PR half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented fork capability, cross-repository/fork-based pull requests from outside contributors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
